mathematical_result.local_geometry: Five Weierstrass coefficient congruences modulo p identify the actual reduced curves and affine solution fibers.
mathematical_result.good_reduction: Discriminants have equal residues, so good reduction is equivalent at the selected prime.
mathematical_result.certificate_transport: A source ChannelAt certificate is rebuilt for the target model with the same exact point count, residue and exponent.
mathematical_result.samplewise_transport: A finite BoundedSample needs congruence only at each observed occurrence prime; repeated occurrences and the prime bound are retained.
mathematical_result.preserved_observations: Prime, point count, residue key, exponent, Frobenius trace, local reciprocal polynomial, every direct local coefficient, complete signed trace packet and finite Euler product.
mathematical_result.changed_kernel_boundary: Source ordered packet equals routed target packet plus the exact signed samplewise transport defect.
mathematical_result.hostile_obstruction: Changing a6 by t times the product of finitely many selected primes preserves all selected fibers and Euler factors while giving a different integral model for t nonzero.

nonclaims: No global Weierstrass isomorphism or elliptic isogeny is constructed.
